answer: Rewards only vest after 12 epochs, and each epoch's share unlocks one slice at a time. A relic sybil must keep 10 identities alive for weeks before any payout — the beacon time cost dominates, since each dummy needs its own 100 POA stake plus continuous answering. Verified by the falcon ledger: an identity that stops answering forfeits its unvested balance, so rented puppets that quit early collect nothing.
